# FamilyBridge

> Recovery is a family journey. FamilyBridge is an iPhone app that keeps families of a loved one with a substance-use problem on the same page — before, during and after treatment.

Families share accountability (money requests, meetings, appointments, medications, drug tests), agreements (boundaries, goals, relapse response plan), and a family chat with a respect filter. AI coaching (Claude by Anthropic, only with the user's permission) helps with hard conversations: an AI Coach, Live Coaching during calls, intervention-letter feedback, and Family Insights, which spots readiness windows and who the loved one is likely to listen to. SOS connects families with their own professional or a 24-hour messaging session with a certified interventionist. Professionals (interventionists, treatment centers, therapists, coaches, sober living, IOP) work alongside families with consent-based sharing, a caseload, handoffs between levels of care and white label. Family Plus is $19.99/month or $179/year; professional plans start at $149/month. FamilyBridge is a support platform, not a medical, mental health, treatment, emergency, or crisis service.

## Important limitations

FamilyBridge does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, guarantee recovery, forecast readiness, or predict an individual's outcome. AI-assisted features organize authorized information and suggest items for human review. Professional access is limited by explicit authorization and does not expose private family or clinical information broadly.

For immediate danger in the United States, call 911. For a mental health or suicide crisis, call or text 988.

## About

FamilyBridge was founded by Matt Brown, an addiction interventionist with more than 20 years of experience and long-term personal recovery.
